nudge: summarize issue priorities
nudge: page all issues
code:
items = []
cursor = None
while True:
    args = {'limit': 2}
    if cursor: args['cursor'] = cursor
    page = (await tools.nudge.list_issues(**args))['data']
    items.extend(page['items'] or [])
    cursor = page.get('nextCursor')
    if not cursor: break
return [x['identifier'] for x in items]

name: nudge: fetch issue details concurrently
code:
page = (await tools.nudge.list_issues(limit=10))['data']
items = page['items'] or []
details = await asyncio.gather(*[tools.nudge.get_issue(id=x['id']) for x in items])
return [{'id': x['data']['identifier'], 'title': x['data']['title']} for x in details]
